summary: Shows ad hoc package management with the yum module: ensure installed without upgrading, install a specific version, upgrade to latest, or remove. Notes alternatives when no module exists for your package manager.
questions: How do I make sure a package is installed but not upgraded?
How do I install a specific package version ad hoc with yum?
How do I upgrade a package to the newest version on all webservers?
How do I uninstall a package across hosts with one command?
What if Ansible has no module for my package manager?

answer_card.title: Manage packages with ad hoc commands
answer_card.answer_md:
Using `ansible.builtin.yum` against `webservers`:
- Installed, don't update: `-a "name=acme state=present"`
- Specific version: `-a "name=acme-1.5 state=present"`
- Latest: `-a "name=acme state=latest"`
- Removed: `-a "name=acme state=absent"`

If no module exists for your package manager, use the `command` module or write a module.
